messages:
Ana (docs): Drafting the relnotes for next week's docs push. Need a short customer-facing blurb + one technical "known issues" section. Any fresh items to call out? :eyes:

Evan (eng): Two things: 1) small change to KV cache behavior to reduce memory churn, 2) a streaming glitch on old websocket shim that can cause truncated embeddings. I'll add repro steps and a link to a middleware workaround.

Marco (sdk): Heads up: we consolidated the JS client constructors. `new RedwoodClient()` now accepts an options object instead of positional args. I'll update snippets and include both old and new examples for a migration note.

Priya (product): Keep the public relnote simple: one line feature highlight + one line about improved perf. Product wants the headline: "Lower token cost for common chat patterns; minor warm-up differences for some apps."

Ana (docs): Using that headline. For the technical page, can we include a tiny compatibility snippet for the constructor migration? Prefer one-liners developers can paste.

Marco (sdk): Sure. Here's a quick two-liner for JS and Python:

```js
// old
const client = new RedwoodClient(apiKey, 'gpt-4-mini')
// new
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey, model: 'gpt-4-mini' })
```

```py
# old
client = RedwoodClient('API_KEY', 'gpt-4-mini')
# new
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='API_KEY', model='gpt-4-mini')
```

Yuki (devex): I'll drop a CI lint that flags positional constructor use in examples repo. Quick grep + test. Will PR today.

Evan (eng): Also flagging one more: links in the embedding guide that point to the old anchor IDs were broken after the docs refactor. I fixed the redirects but we should list the broken anchor as a known doc bug and note the redirect mapping.

Ana (docs): Good catch. Can you paste the redirect mapping here so I can include it in the relnotes? Even a single example is fine.

Evan (eng): Example redirect: `/docs/api/embeddings#batching` -> `/docs/api/embeddings#batch-usage`. I'll add the full list to the PR.

Priya (product): Also let's call out the SDK param rename we did last sprint: `max_tokens` -> `token_limit`. Customers saw it in beta. Make the relnote say we added a compatibility flag in the client for now.

Marco (sdk): Confirmed: client will accept both keys for one release and warn on stdout. I'll include the one-line warning example for the docs.

Ana (docs): Perfect. Anything else? Localization team asked to hold off translations until the staging build is green.

BuildBot: staging docs build started for branch `release/docs-216000`  logs: https://ci.internal/builds/216000 :gear:

Yuki (devex): I'll queue the CI snippet PR (#578) and link it once it's up. Also adding a brief test that exercises both `max_tokens` and `token_limit` paths.

Ana (docs): Action items: Marco -> update snippets + include dual examples in relnotes, Evan -> paste full redirect list + streaming repro, Yuki -> PR for CI tests, Priya -> final approve of customer blurb. I'll assemble draft relnote and ping for review by Tuesday EOD.

Priya (product): Approved. Please keep the public blurb short.

Ana (docs): Draft will be posted here in the morning for a quick copy-edit. Thanks everyone :pray:
